01 — About

I'm Gong Xi — a digital media practitioner and video director who bridges AI technology with editorial aesthetics.

Currently pursuing my MSc in AI & Digital Media at Hong Kong Baptist University. I specialize in AIGC-powered content production, high-conversion short-form video advertising, and data-driven social media operations for beauty and lifestyle brands.

My work sits at the intersection of creativity and logic. I don't just craft engaging narratives — I use data analytics (SQL, Python) to deconstruct performance and drive measurable growth. I'm passionate about leveraging AI workflows to scale content production, optimize ROI, and redefine what's possible in the digital space.
